title: AI Stocks: The HALO Trade As A Hedge Against The AI Sell-Off
summary: After investors spent years pouring money into AI stocks, the newly coined "HALO" trade is gaining credence on Wall Street, as a hedge against the impact artificial intelligence is broadly projected to have on the economy, as well as on stocks.
